name: open_postings
title: Open postings
description: Open the apply pages of up to 50 postings in the user's web browser, one tab each. Only plain http and https links open. Use only when the user asks to open them.

ids.description: Up to 50 posting ids whose apply pages to open
ids.title: Ids

name: export_postings
title: Export postings
description: Save the postings that match the same filters as search_postings to a new csv, md, json or pdf file in the user's Downloads folder, and return its path. It never replaces a file. Use only when the user asks for a file.

file_type.description: csv for spreadsheets, md for notes, json for programs, pdf to print
file_type.title: File Type

words.description: Words to find in titles, employers and descriptions. Leave empty to list the newest postings instead.
words.title: Words

location.description: montreal, canada (the rest of Canada), usa, or unknown
location.title: Location

term.description: A term such as summer-2027, or unknown
term.title: Term

language.description: The language the posting is written in
language.title: Language

company.description: Exact employer name, such as Shopify
company.title: Company

mine.description: Apply the places, roles, terms and employers the user saved
mine.title: Mine

untracked.description: Leave out every posting the user saved, applied to or hid
untracked.title: Untracked

days.description: Only postings first seen in the last N days; 0 means any age. Without words the default is 14; with words it is any age.
days.title: Days

name: start_sync
title: Start a sync
description: Start collecting new postings from the job boards in the background, like stage sync in a terminal. It takes several minutes and only one runs at a time; database_status shows its progress. Use only when the user asks for a sync.
